Battleground
Bamboo Dueling Ground
A stone yard surrounded by bamboo. Hide behind the thickets and close in
Frozen Lake Snowfield
A frozen lake with ice pillars. Open in the middle, snowy hills at the edges
Volcanic Basin
Two-tier terraces inside a lava-filled crater. Take the high ground
Cloud Pavilions
Three pavilions and bridges floating above the clouds. Fall and you're out
Brown Horse
The horse everyone starts with
Black Dragon Steed
A black charger with a red mane
White Tiger
A white tiger that bounds across the ground
Azure Dragon
💎 Robux item. A scaled dragon that swims through the sky. The fastest
Winged Cloud
Glide on a cloud. Fastest after the Azure Dragon
Black Dragon
💎 Robux item. A black-scaled dragon wreathed in red flame (fastest after the Azure Dragon)
Blood Flame Steed
Pitch-black with a burning mane. Blood-red flames rise from every hoof (combat mythic achievements: Invincible · Bane of Bosses)
Heavenly White Tiger
A white tiger with glowing blue stripes, scattering starlit frost (style and world mythic achievements: Every Fist Under Heaven · Master of Signatures · Heavenly Manuals)
Rainbow Cloud
A cloud swirling with seven colors that leaves a rainbow behind (challenge and dueling mythic achievements: End of Calamity · King of Clouds · Master of the Tower · First Fist of the World)
Edge of the World

With the Heavenly Lord on his knees, the edges of the land stir. Hwangsa, lord of the Yellow Dust Canyon in the east, and the Eastern Ember Lord, who rules the plains of undying flame, are expanding their reach. Defeat both.
North and West

The northern end of the world is frozen and the western end is buried in sand. Defeat the North Emperor of the Northern Ice Plains and the Western Snake King of the Western Dunes, and set foot on all four ends of the land.
Islands in the Sky

Beyond the Sky Palace, every island among the clouds has a master. The Ice Emperor of the Frost Crystal Palace, Bicheon of the Flying Falls, Aurora of the Aurora Terrace. Heavenly materials come from the places they guard.
Forest Above the Clouds
Old things live on the higher islands. Get past the Crane Sage of Blue Crane Peak, the Bamboo King of the Misty Bamboo Grove, and the Flame Phoenix of the Phoenix Terrace.
Gate of the Immortal Realm
At Beyond Heaven, the immortal realm opens its gate. Wolyeong of Moonlight Lake, Doseon of the Immortal Garden, and the Diamond Heaven King of Golden Cloud Temple. The last gatekeepers of the sky.
Dragon's Ridge
A reborn body can see farther into the sky. Defeat the Flying Dragon of Dragon Spine Ridge, the Glass Lord of the Glass Sea, and Cheonroe of the Sky Prison.
Dragon Above the Clouds
At the top of the Cloud Dragon Terrace, the Cloud Dragon King, wrapped in clouds, blocks the way through the sky.
Beyond the Sky Gate
At the end of the sky there is a gate. Pass the Immortal King of Immortal Lake and the Soaring King of the Soaring Gate, and there's nowhere higher to climb in the sky.
Hwangcheon Ferry

Those who have seen the end of the sky see beneath the earth. At the far southeast end of the world, where faint grass gives underfoot, pay the reaper his fare and calm the restless spirits, and hell opens. Defeat Taluipa of the Three Crossings River and the Boiling Cauldron King of the Cauldron Hell.
A king's seat is tested even in hell. Defeat the Blade Mountain Lord of the Blade Mountain Hell and the Hungry Ghost King of the Hungry Ghost Realm.
Fifth Life
Be reborn again as Fist King. In your fifth life, the realm above Fist King, Grand Luo, opens.
Reach Grand Luo, the sky that casts a great net.
Before the Karma Mirror
Yama's Hall at the heart of hell. Face your past lives reflected in the Karma Mirror and defeat King Yama.
Reaching the Apex
Even styles have an end. Apex Sun-Moon Fist between sun and moon, Apex Null Fist of the empty coordinates, Apex Lightspeed Fist that lands before light. Find a hidden master and learn one Apex style.
Sixth Life
The last rebirth. In your sixth life, Nothingness opens.
Reach Nothingness, where everything empties and fills again. It's the last realm.
Depths of Hell
Hell goes deeper the lower you go. Defeat the Viper King of the Viper Hell, the Tongue King of the Tongue-Pulling Hell, and the lord of endlessly falling Avici.
Three Apexes
Learn all three Apex styles. When the three come together, what lies beyond opens.
Cave of the Divine

At the far northwest of the world, directly opposite the entrance to hell, stands a man-shaped stone. With five rebirths, offer 999 ten-thousand silver and a cave opens below. Send the energy of the Apex styles to the three pedestals in turn to gain the Divine Three Powers Fist.
Bottom of Hell
The bottom of hell: the pool of blood, the ice prison, the valley of chains. Defeat the Blood Pool King, the Frost King and the Iron Ball King, and the great war of hell is over.

You've walked both the end of the sky and the floor of hell. Now there's no one in the martial world who doesn't know your name. Styles left to learn, hidden masters, the top of the Thousand-Floor Tower. The bare-handed road never ends.
Elder Cheongun
Welcome to the martial world. So another young one has come to make a name with nothing but bare hands.
Come talk to me first. Just follow the yellow guide.
Your body reaching a realm doesn't mean you've risen to it.
Get past me. Then comes the next realm.
The Thousand-Floor Tower. Enemies get stronger with every floor.
Fall down or fall off and you start over. A master waits every ten floors.
Martial World
You've defeated a hundred in the Battleground. Your name has started to spread across the martial world.
Peerless Divine Fist. A fist honed to beat people is yours.
Black Tiger
No one who's set foot in my fort has ever left alive.
Blood Wolf
Followed the smell of blood here? You came to the wrong place.
Ice Demon
This snow mountain is my home. If you're lost, turn back now.
It's been a while since anyone walked all the way into the Blood Cult's headquarters.
I'm the one who ran the Blood Cult. Coming this far bare-handed deserves some praise.
Flame Emperor
The mountain of fire never lets those who enter leave.
Snake King
I slept a thousand years. Someone has to pay for waking me.
Heaven Gate General
The gate of heaven doesn't open for just anyone.
Sky Palace Gatekeeper
This is the Heavenly Realm. Names earned on the ground don't reach here.
The Heavenly Lord has never left his throne. Go and see for yourself.
Thunder Emperor
Heaven's lightning doesn't ask twice.
Star Lord
You're interrupting my star counting. Let's end this quickly.
Let's see how far a fist from the ground can reach.
Ice Emperor
Everyone who entered this palace froze from the feet up. You'll be the same soon.
Flame Phoenix
A phoenix doesn't die. It just rises again from its ashes.
Pungyeop
Turn back before all the leaves fall. That's my last warning.
Stone King
I've stood for a thousand years. I'm not a stone that crumbles to the likes of you.
Spore King
Breathe sparingly in this forest. The spores lodge in your lungs.
Tea Immortal
I'll finish this before the tea leaves settle.
Bicheon
Water falling from the sky pierces even rock.
Crane Sage
Once a crane spreads its wings, it flies only above the clouds.
Bamboo King
Bamboo doesn't break. It bends, then strikes you.
Wolyeong
Have you ever cut the moon reflected in a lake?
Diamond Heaven King
I've guarded this temple's gate a long time. Let's see if your fists hold up.
Taluipa
To cross the Three Crossings River, lay down everything of this world. This tree weighs your sins.
Boiling Cauldron King
This cauldron has never once cooled. Your turn now.
Blade Mountain Lord
Every blade on this mountain belonged to a sinner. I'll add yours.
Hungry Ghost King
I'm hungry. No matter how much I eat, I'm always hungry. You'll take some chewing.
King Yama
It's been a while since a living person came this far. Let's see how the Karma Mirror shows you.
Cheongeop
I am Cheongeop. Hard to survive alone. Bring your companions.
Double Training
Permanent
All training stat gains doubled forever
Stacks with Summoning Pills, enhanced training and auto training
Inner Demon Duel rewards doubled too
Auto Training
Presses for you on every beat in the training screen ('Good')
Stops when you leave the training spot (doesn't level you anywhere)
Easier on your hands, but no faster than a person
Advanced Auto Training
Presses 'Perfect' for you on every beat in the training screen
Works in enhanced training too
Stops when you leave the training spot
Double Silver
Silver from enemies, bosses and the Tower doubled forever
One-time rewards like achievements and the codex stay the same
Fill what needs silver (styles, manuals, mounts) much faster
Bag Expansion
Carry Wound Salves: 5 → 10
Easier to restock all at once at the village shop
Twice as many heals in big fights (bosses, raids)

The fastest of all mounts (×3.1)
Golden horns and whiskers, golden dust flowing along its body
Double Kills

Grunts, elites, bosses and the Tower alike
Stacks with Double Training (training for training, kills for kills)
Lucky Charm
Double boss manual scroll chance (15% → 30%)
Double heavenly material drop chance (max two at once still applies)
Sky gems from heavenly enemies x1.5
A golden 👑 before your name overhead
Style mastery rises twice as fast
Silver from enemies and bosses +25% (stacks with Double Silver)
Fourth Manual Slot
Equip four manuals instead of three
One more slot of HP, attack, lifesteal and cooldown effects
A fourth slot opens in the manual screen
Black Dragon Mount
A black-scaled dragon wreathed in red flame
Fastest after the Azure Dragon (×3.0; the Azure Dragon is still the fastest)
The Black Dragon's own flame aura flows along its body

Subspace Sage
Cracked Void (Heavenly Realm)
Space isn't empty. It's folded.
They say an invisible bridge stretches into the void from the west end of the Cloud Plain in the Heavenly Realm
Grid Keeper
Beyond the End of the World (Garden of Oblivion)
Unfold it and you'll see. Even a blank has coordinates.
They say beyond the World's End Cliffs, in a garden floating at the end of a crumbling stone path, someone draws grids in the air
Twilight Fist Sovereign
Rebirth Terrace (Heavenly Realm)
Neither sun nor moon clings to one side. The Apex lies in that balance.
They say on the Heavenly Rebirth Terrace, in the sunset between sun and moon, stands one who was Fist Sovereign before the Fist Sovereign
Racing Ghost
Underworld (Hwangcheon Ferry)
Being fast isn't hurrying. It's having nothing extra.
They say a ghost faster than the reaper stands at the Hwangcheon Ferry beyond the afterlife
Drifting Cloud Master
Sky Palace (Heavenly Realm)
Push a cloud and it doesn't scatter.
They say an old man sits like a cloud in the pavilion northwest of the Sky Palace in the Heavenly Realm
Old Iron Chain
East of Cheongun Fields
A fist can miss. A hand that has grabbed doesn't.
They say an old man with iron chains wrapped around his waist is in the east of the fields south of Cheongun Village
Countercurrent Wanderer
West of Cheongun Fields
Whoever strikes first loses first.
They say someone always stands with eyes closed in the west of the fields south of Cheongun Village
Gale Youth
Fields southeast of Cheongun Village
Wind that stops is no longer wind.
They say a young man who never stays still is in the fields southeast of Cheongun Village
Mountain Crusher Patriarch
A mountain falls all at once. It takes a thousand years to build up for that once.
They say an old man sits like a mountain on a cracked rocky hill south of the red wasteland
Ice Soul Nun
Ice cliffs of the northern snow mountains
Ice isn't cold. It just doesn't move.
They say a nun with white breath is before the frozen waterfall under the ice cliffs east of the northern snow mountains
Jade Sage
Jade pillars of the Stone Forest
Jade shines the more it's carved. So do people.
They say someone sits carving stone among the jade-blue pillars of the Stone Forest at the far west
Bell Keeper
Top of Maple Mountain
A bell doesn't ring on its own. It rings when someone strikes it.
They say someone rings the old bell once a day atop Maple Mountain at the far northeast
Clear Mirror Immortal
Mirror Pond of the Misty Tea Fields
A mirror reflects anything. That's why it holds on to nothing.
They say an immortal sits by a mirror-clear pond in the middle of the misty tea fields at the far northwest
Heavenly Dragon Sage
Dragon's spine east of Dragon Peak
Relax to hit far. Even a dragon doesn't fight the wind.
They say a golden-bearded sage stands on rocks rising like a dragon's spine east of Heavenly Dragon Peak
Overlord
Fallen Throne of Yellow Dust Canyon
Thrones fall quickly. What remains is what your body has learned.
They say a man sits alone on a fallen stone throne in the Yellow Dust Canyon at the far east
Starry River Elder
Deep in the Nebula Garden (Heavenly Realm)
Stars don't fall. They come down.
They say an old man counts stars behind the Star Lord in the deepest part of the Nebula Garden in the Heavenly Realm
Cherry Fan Immortal
Deep in the Plum Garden (cherry hill)
Petals move with the wind. Use a fan the same way.
They say someone with a fan is on a hill where cherry blossoms fall out of season, deepest in the Plum Garden
Dead-Drunk Immortal
South of the Drunken Immortal Inn (wine-jar porch)
Staggering is a technique too. Those who stand as if about to fall stand the longest.
They say a little way down the south road from the Drunken Immortal Inn, an old man with a towel tied around his head snores on a porch piled high with wine jars
Blood Moon Immortal
Outside the Blood Cult HQ (blood-moon altar)
Waver at the sight of blood and you lose right then. A scythe always draws the same arc.
They say beyond the northeast wall of the Blood Cult HQ, a red scythe is stuck upside-down in a stone altar under a blood-red moon
Thunder Heaven Immortal
East cliff edge of the Storm Plateau (iron-pillar peak)
